text_block_list.text:
After school, hearing an energetic voice from the rooftop,
I went up to check and found Katsuragi Ace――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――"Look down and you'll only see your own shadow!
Always look forward and keep pressing on!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my bad, my bad!
Looks like I gave you a fright.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm practicing my speech for the school assembly.
Chairwoman Akikawa personally asked me to give a talk that would boost student morale!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just thinking that my speech might change
everyone gives me a huge surge of motivation...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna seize victory in this major showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna practice until I'm fully satisfied today!
Feel free to stick around and listen!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Studying! Racing! Even just playing around!
I want you to pick one thing and give it your absolute all!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "――In short, it's a matter of mindset! If you do it while hating every second, you'll just drag yourself down! To put it concretely――"
Even after 30 minutes had passed, there was no sign of Katsuragi Ace's speech ending anytime soon...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "――Even so, when you feel like breaking, lean on those around you! Because we're all students of the same Tracen Academy!!"
choice_data_list: Hold on, stop! ...That's quite a masterpiece, isn't it?
Hold on, stop! ...That's quite a masterpiece, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we're just about halfway through so far.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The Chairwoman is counting on me, so I can't deliver a half-baked speech, can I?
choice_data_list: Impressive! With a few tweaks, it'll be even better!
Impressive! With a few tweaks, it'll be even better!
(I should be patient and listen to the very end.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: The Chairwoman is counting on me, so I can't deliver a half-baked speech, can I?
choice_data_list: Impressive! With a few tweaks, it'll be even better!
Impressive! With a few tweaks, it'll be even better!
(I should be patient and listen to the very end.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You got a good idea?
Let's hear it!
A long-winded speech only causes people to tune out. I advised Katsuragi Ace to keep it short and punchy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, makes sense!
So keeping it short gets the point across better!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeaaah!!
This'll make the speech so much better!!
Katsuragi Ace keeps revising her speech. However, her motivation threatens to run wild again and turn it into another epic novel, making it impossible to take your eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright then, full throttle all the way to the finish!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"――I believe in everyone's power!
Let's do this! Let's show 'em what we've got, everyone!
Thank you very much for listening!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Having a listener made for great practice!
Thanks to you, I'm in top shape. Much obliged!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone, just you wait! I'm gonna give the greatest speech ever!
Once Katsuragi Ace gets fired up, she loses all restraint. You silently pray that this masterpiece won't become even longer during the real thing!
